top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Background Check Validation - Once a year listed family homes, licensed, and registered child care homes must validate list of subjects (26 TAC §745.651(2)(B))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the follow-up inspection the owner validation check was not done.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §747.901(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Three staff did not have a completed Pre-Employment Affidavit in their personnel record.

top_violation_types.title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was a dog in the backyard without vaccinations record.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §747.2321(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There were no written feeding instructions for the infant in care.

top_violation_types.title: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used (26 TAC §747.3303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children's diapers are being changed on a diaper changing mat in an area that children play in.

top_violation_types.title: Required Health Statement (26 TAC §747.611(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two of the four children records reviewed were missing health statements.

top_violation_types.title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §747.2326(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant was found asleep in a car seat while in care. This was corrected when the operation staff was asked to remove the infant from the car seat.
